question: Should Workspaces expose state:persist and its gateway/SQLite contract as a permanent approved-widget API, and if so should that contract land separately before the built-in notes consumer?
rationale: The branch crosses the untrusted-widget boundary and creates persistent API and storage contracts; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the intended permanent ownership or stacked landing policy.

options.title: Land the contract first
options.body: Approve and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 as the canonical persistence API, then rebase this PR to contain only the notes consumer and its focused fixes and proof.

options.title: Accept the cumulative branch
options.body: Approve this PR as the combined persistence-plus-notes landing unit, then close the companion PR after resolving findings, upgrade evidence, and real-browser proof.

options.title: Defer widget persistence
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers want to commit to a permanent state:persist capability and stored-data contract.

recommendation.title: Land the contract first
recommendation.body: Approve and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 as the canonical persistence API, then rebase this PR to contain only the notes consumer and its focused fixes and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline provides the clearest direct maintainer-routing signal for this security- and product-boundary decision.
